includedVariants: UK pedestrian crossing warning signs with the crossing pedestrian symbol
UK warning signs showing children crossing or nearby
excludedVariants: School names without the children warning symbol

includedVariants: UK roadworks warning signs showing the worker symbol
UK no pedestrians prohibition signs with the pedestrian symbol
excludedVariants: Handwritten requests to avoid an area

includedVariants: Fixed street-name plates identifying a road, street or lane
excludedVariants: Street names printed only on maps

includedVariants: UK shared pedestrian and cycle path signs showing both pedestrian and cycle symbols
Fixed bus stop identification signs and readable attached stop-name plates
excludedVariants: Timetables without a visible bus stop identification sign

includedVariants: Fixed street furniture such as poles, bins, benches, bollards and fixed barriers
Stationary traffic cones or temporary barriers whose position is visible in the scene
excludedVariants: Objects whose visible bounds cannot be annotated reliably
